author: Vettori
quote: Beautiful game, has you smiling and feeling like a kid all over. This is an amazing remake of a wonderful game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Vettori
quote: Pretty disappointed. The game tries to be a simulator with being able to walk up and down aisles in a supermarket, but then stop me cheating on Lucia. Theres no hookers, can’t gamble or even flatten protestors in my car… visually looks nice, but oooufff that 30fps… Dunno, hope they patch it soon.
